_note: Development / confirmation (held-out) split of the 10k cohort (cpu-prep, researcher 2026-11-12). Assignment per person: u = int(sha256('hts-split-' + SEED + ':' + pid)) / 2^256; dev if u < dev_share, else confirm. Persons used in earlier dry runs are forced to dev. Independent of the population definition, so any later pool is a subset with the same sides.
